derivation: or (feminine) רְעָדָהxlit rᵉâdâh corrected to rᵉʻâdâh; from H7460 (רָעַד);

occurrences.text: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
